target.what: Arm_motion_bench's BAM FB workspace v2 dev000 tape at 0.5 (ISO 9283 line + rectangle, bam_ruckig), every time x1 (nominal). Tests tracking on a fixed target at this speed.

configs.title: the trajectory's column (as built), board PD
configs.why: the as-built baseline (the tape's own column, board PD, no lookahead: what the arm runs today); twin at bam_fivebar/path@nominal·50Hz·bus=datasheet·ff±10%·gains×1: tool p95 12.2 mm, joint p95 0.794 deg
configs.feedback: the boards' PD at the station's own gains (fullarm_jtc's on bam_fb)

configs.title: model at plan time, computed-torque gains re-sent each tick, calibrated lookahead
configs.why: real-safe #1 for accuracy of 12 passing at bam_fivebar/path@nominal·50Hz·bus=datasheet·ff±10%·gains×1: tool p95 1.5 mm, joint p95 0.613 deg
configs.feedback: computed-torque gains re-sent with every command: kp = M_jj(q_ref)·ωn², kd = 2ζωn·M_jj(q_ref) (ζ 0.9, 6.78 Hz), as moteus kp_scale / kd_scale over the boards' configured gains
configs.lookahead_source: the twin's calibrated bus delay at 50 Hz on the stagger bus (§5.2)

configs.title: model at plan time, computed-torque gains re-sent each tick, calibrated lookahead, secant_mid_ff
configs.why: real-safe #2 for accuracy of 12 passing at bam_fivebar/path@nominal·50Hz·bus=datasheet·ff±10%·gains×1: tool p95 1.54 mm, joint p95 0.605 deg
configs.feedback: computed-torque gains re-sent with every command: kp = M_jj(q_ref)·ωn², kd = 2ζωn·M_jj(q_ref) (ζ 0.9, 6.78 Hz), as moteus kp_scale / kd_scale over the boards' configured gains
configs.lookahead_source: the twin's calibrated bus delay at 50 Hz on the stagger bus (§5.2)
configs.interpolation_in_bundle: qd <- (q(t + T) - q(t)) / T and effort <- effort(t + T/2), T = the JTC's tick period

configs.title: model + Coulomb at plan time, board PD, calibrated lookahead
configs.why: real-safe #3 for accuracy of 12 passing at bam_fivebar/path@nominal·50Hz·bus=datasheet·ff±10%·gains×1: tool p95 4.79 mm, joint p95 0.421 deg
configs.feedback: the boards' PD at the station's own gains (fullarm_jtc's on bam_fb)
configs.lookahead_source: the twin's calibrated bus delay at 50 Hz on the stagger bus (§5.2)

calibration.why: xcorr on bam_fivebar/calibration·50Hz·bus=stagger·ff±0%·gains×1 (one run at zero lookahead, each joint's best-aligning shift): measured 4.25/13.50/17.75/9.75/12.50/14.75 ms vs nominal 1.25/2.50/3.75/5.00/6.25/7.50 ms (datasheet:mjbots (fdcanusb ~800 Hz, one device)): off by +3.00/+11.00/+14.00/+4.75/+6.25/+7.25 ms, beyond the 2 ms tolerance
calibration.bus_why: xcorr on bam_fivebar/calibration·50Hz·bus=stagger·ff±0%·gains×1 (one run at zero lookahead, each joint's best-aligning shift with the friction look-alike fitted out): measured 2.75/11.50/14.00/9.00/11.25/13.50 ms vs nominal 1.25/2.50/3.75/5.00/6.25/7.50 ms (datasheet:mjbots (fdcanusb ~800 Hz, one device)): off by +1.50/+9.00/+10.25/+4.00/+5.00/+6.00 ms, beyond the 2 ms tolerance

score_against: the bundle's q_reference on the JTC's leg clock (robot_controllers.real.import_fullarm)
logger_ask: stamp each exchange's start and the order the boards are served in (or each reply's own time): with the exchange's end alone, one run bounds the delay only to one exchange (~17 ms), so the calibration is the sweep
why: robot_controllers never drives hardware (CONTRACT §5.9): the rig's owner builds and queues these
